scope: Science wall includes in-run setup, model construction, training, calibration metrics, rescaling fits, checkpoint/JSON I/O, frozen selection, test evaluation and CSV export. Training-plus-snapshots excludes model/trainer construction and final test. Both timers start after Python imports; separate engineering evaluator plumbing and tests are not included in these timers. Allocated-GPU wall is a conservative compute measure, not GPU-kernel active time. No failed/restarted scientific runs.
